race.title: Safer Gambling Week 2026 Fillies Maiden
race.verdict: RHAPSODIC is bound to improve on her debut sixth at Leopardstown last month so Dermot Weld's filly is put forward as the answer with this marked step up in trip holding no fears. Serendipia has plenty of decent efforts to her name so she could be the one to give the selection most to think about on all-weather bow. Blue Nasturtium rounds off the shortlist. RHAPSODIC SERENDIPIA (IRE) BLUE NASTURTIUM (IRE)
